paraphrase: Each divine abiding has a near and a far enemy: greed is the near enemy of loving-kindness and ill will its far enemy; home-based grief is the near enemy of compassion and cruelty the far; home-based joy the near enemy of gladness and aversion (boredom) the far; the home-based equanimity of unknowing the near enemy of equanimity, and greed and resentment the far.
